_note: v2 hooks for la Rue des Débardeurs (ST_porteurs, S03_market), a summer market street of crates and hand-carts off the Place du Marché, the put-carry-throw-open-close street (ST_control seg005-009). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret colour = verb group.

fr_mettre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PUTS a gold METRE rule across the vegetable crate (METR).
fr_mettre_verb.why: METRE → mettre = to put, to place (mettre la table). GOLD beret = irregular.

fr_rouler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ROLLS a big barrel along the cobbles: ROLL-ay (roo-LAY).
fr_rouler_verb.why: ROLL → rouler = to roll; to drive (rouler un tonneau). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_fermer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe swings the FARM gate shut beside the MAYpole: FARM-MAY – he CLOSES it (fair-MAY).
fr_fermer_verb.why: FARM + MAY → fermer = to close, to shut (fermer la porte). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_attraper_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe CATCHES the runaway tomatoes in a wire TRAP: a-TRAP-ay (a-tra-PAY).
fr_attraper_verb.why: TRAP → attraper = to catch (attraper le ballon). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_casser_verb.hook: Oops! Monsieur Verbe's CASSEROLE dish BREAKS on the cobbles (ka-SAY).
fr_casser_verb.why: CASSEROLE → casser = to break (casser un verre). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_deposer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PUTS DOWN his crate of POSIES: de-POSIES (day-po-ZAY).
fr_deposer_verb.why: POSIES → déposer = to put down, to drop off (déposer un colis). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_jeter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe THROWS a paper JET into the water tub (zhuh-TAY).
fr_jeter_verb.why: JET → jeter = to throw, to throw away (jeter la balle). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_porter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the PORTER CARRIES a big crate on his back (por-TAY).
fr_porter_verb.why: PORTER → porter = to carry; to wear (porter un carton). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_poser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe strikes a POSE as he PUTS his basket DOWN (po-ZAY).
fr_poser_verb.why: POSE → poser = to put down, to lay (pose ton sac ici). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_retourner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TURNS the crate upside down over his head: RE-TURN it! (ruh-toor-NAY).
fr_retourner_verb.why: RE-TURN → retourner = to turn over; to go back (retourner une caisse). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_enlever_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe uses a long LEVER to TAKE the lid OFF the crate (ahn-luh-VAY).
fr_enlever_verb.why: LEVER → enlever = to remove, to take off (enlever son manteau). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_placer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PLACES a PLATE on the café table (pla-SAY).
fr_placer_verb.why: PLATE/PLACE → placer = to place, to put (placer une assiette). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_lancer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe LAUNCHES a red ball high for the dog: LANCE it! (lahn-SAY).
fr_lancer_verb.why: LAUNCH → lancer = to throw, to launch (lancer la balle). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_precipiter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RUSHES his lemonade so fast it splashes – a PRECIPITATE gulp!
fr_precipiter_verb.why: PRECIPITATE → précipiter = to rush, to hurry; to hurl down (ne précipite rien). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_couvrir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe COVERS his crate of strawberries with a checked cloth (koo-VREER).
fr_couvrir_verb.why: COVER → couvrir = to cover (couvrir un panier). GOLD beret = irregular. (like ouvrir)

fr_recouvrir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RE-COVERS the ice cart with its big canvas (ruh-koo-VREER).
fr_recouvrir_verb.why: RE-COVER → recouvrir = to cover over, to cover again (recouvrir la charrette). GOLD beret = irregular. (like ouvrir)

fr_frissonner_verb.hook: Brrr! Behind the ice blocks Monsieur Verbe SHIVERS: FREEZE-ON! (free-so-NAY).
fr_frissonner_verb.why: FREEZE → frissonner = to shiver, to shudder (frissonner de froid). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_ebranler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SHAKES a sieve full of BRAN until the whole tub rattles (ay-brahn-LAY).
fr_ebranler_verb.why: BRAN → ébranler = to shake, to rattle (ébranler les murs). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_filer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe DASHES OFF with a salmon FILLET, a cat at his heels (fee-LAY).
fr_filer_verb.why: FILLET → filer = to dash off, to run (il file au marché); also to spin. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_raccrocher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe HANGS UP the telephone back on its CROCHET hook (ra-kro-SHAY).
fr_raccrocher_verb.why: RE-CROCHET hook → raccrocher = to hang up, to hang back (raccrocher le téléphone). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_renverser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe KNOCKS OVER the milk churn – REVERSE, upside down! (rahn-vair-SAY).
fr_renverser_verb.why: REVERSE → renverser = to knock over, to spill (renverser du lait). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_clore_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe's red lobster CLAWS the shutter CLOSED (KLOR).
fr_clore_verb.why: CLAW → clore = to close, to end (clore la séance). GOLD beret = irregular. (defective verb)

fr_rouvrir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe REOPENS the crate and a little kangaROO hops out: ROO-VREER (roo-VREER).
fr_rouvrir_verb.why: kangaROO + OPEN → rouvrir = to reopen (rouvrir la boutique). GOLD beret = irregular. (like ouvrir)

fr_renier_verb.hook: Arms crossed, Monsieur Verbe DENIES the horse is his: RE-NEIGH! (ruh-NYAY).
fr_renier_verb.why: NEIGH → renier = to deny, to disown (renier sa parole). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_balancer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SWINGS high on the swing, BALANCING a tray of cups (ba-lahn-SAY).
fr_balancer_verb.why: BALANCE → balancer = to swing, to sway (balancer les jambes). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_rougir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BLUSHES ROUGE-red when the lady offers him a ROSE (roo-ZHEER).
fr_rougir_verb.why: ROUGE → rougir = to blush, to turn red (rougir de plaisir). GREEN beret = regular -ir.

fr_arrondir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ROUNDS the dough into A ROUND loaf (a-rohn-DEER).
fr_arrondir_verb.why: A ROUND → arrondir = to round, to round off (arrondir la pâte). GREEN beret = regular -ir.

fr_courber_verb.hook: Mirror in hand, Monsieur Verbe BENDS himself double under the low CURVED arch: CURVE-ay (koor-BAY).
fr_courber_verb.why: CURVE → se courber = to bend down, to stoop (se courber pour passer). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_entrouvrir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe HALF-OPENS the shutter and peeps out: ENTER... OPEN a crack (ahn-troo-VREER).
fr_entrouvrir_verb.why: ENTER + OPEN → entrouvrir = to half-open, to open slightly (entrouvrir la fenêtre). GOLD beret = irregular. (like ouvrir)

fr_declencher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe tugs the rope and SETS OFF the bell: DAY-CLANG-SHAY! (day-klahn-SHAY).
fr_declencher_verb.why: CLANG → déclencher = to set off, to trigger (déclencher l'alarme). RED beret = regular -er.
ex: Il tire la corde pour déclencher la cloche.
He pulls the rope to set off the bell.
